program_name: Precision Livestock Farming (PLF) — official bilingual denomination used in the Rectoral admission decree: "corso di laurea magistrale in Precision Livestock Farming (Zootecnica di Precisione)". The Italian denomination "Zootecnica di Precisione" is the legal parallel title; the SUA-CdS record registers the course name simply as "Precision Livestock Farming" (Didactic Regulations, Art. 1: "Nome del Corso: Precision Livestock Farming"). Standalone programme — it is NOT a curriculum/track inside a larger Italian-taught degree: it has its own SUA-CdS record, its own Didactic Regulations (Regolamento LM86 R PLSF, in force from a.y. 2025-2026), its own annual Rectoral admission decree and its own Didactic Coordination Commission (CCD). Promoted and delivered by the Department of Veterinary Medicine and Animal Production (Dipartimento di Medicina Veterinaria e Produzioni Animali, DMVPA), School of Agriculture and Veterinary Medicine (Scuola di Agraria e Veterinaria). Duration 2 years, 120 CFU/ECTS. The programme was activated in a.y. 2019/2020 and is presented by the University as the first degree of its kind in the world (unina.it news item: "Alla Federico II i primi laureati al mondo in Precision Livestock Farming"); it was created under a collaboration agreement between Federico II and the Campania Region, which supplies the Improsta experimental farm as the teaching site. Faculty are drawn from DMVPA plus the Departments of Agricultural Sciences, Chemical/Materials/Industrial Production Engineering, Electrical Engineering and Information Technologies, and Political Sciences.
level: Master (second-cycle) — Italian "Laurea Magistrale" (2-year Master's degree, laurea magistrale biennale), 120 CFU (University Educational Credits / ECTS), 4 semesters. Entry qualification required: "Laurea I Livello" (first-level/bachelor's degree, three-year), per the orientamento.unina.it course sheet header ("Degree required Laurea I Livello"). Didactic Regulations, Art. 9: "La durata legale del Corso di Studio è di 2 anni ... Lo studente dovrà acquisire 120 CFU". The degree is awarded after passing no more than 12 examinations totalling 108 CFU plus the final exam. Awarded degree: Dottore Magistrale in the LM-86 class; the qualification also gives access to the State examination for registration in Section A of the Professional Register of Agronomists and Foresters (Albo di Dottore Agronomo e Dottore Forestale).
teaching_language: English — 100% English-medium, confirmed by four independent official sources with no conflicting evidence. (a) The orientamento.unina.it course sheet header states "Language ENG" (not the "ITA/ENG" tag used for Federico II's bilingual programmes). (b) The Didactic Regulations quote the SUA-CdS framework directly: "Lingua in cui si tiene il corso: Inglese" and state in Art. 1 "Il Corso è tenuto in lingua inglese." (c) The 2026/27 Rectoral admission decree repeatedly describes the course as "erogato in Lingua inglese" / "erogato in lingua inglese ed in forma residenziale presso l'azienda agricola regionale Improsta". (d) international.unina.it lists it in the International Course Catalogue under "2-year Master's degrees (LM) — Veterinary Medicine" as "Precision Livestock Farming – ENG". Every course in the published study plan is delivered in English, and the final thesis defence is oral "in English" (orientamento portal: "the candidate will present an oral dissertation in English of the work by the graduating student"). No Italian-language modules appear anywhere in the study plan, and the study plan contains no "further language skills" credit block. Teaching is conventional/in-presence ("Modalità di erogazione del corso: Convenzionale") and, uniquely among Federico II's English-taught degrees, fully RESIDENTIAL at the Improsta farm. Note that the admission call itself (the legally binding document) is published only in Italian; the Department has in past years published an unofficial English synthesis "made only for publicity purposes", which states that "only the Italian version of the act is valid, and prevailing" — see uncertainty_notes.
campus:
NOT a Naples city campus. The entire programme is taught residentially at the Improsta Regional Experimental Farm (Azienda Agricola Regionale Sperimentale Improsta), SS 18 Tirrena Inferiore, Km 79+800, 84025 EBOLI (SA), Italy — in the province of Salerno, roughly 85 km south-east of Naples, not in the Naples metropolitan area and not on any of the University's usual sites (Monte Sant'Angelo, Policlinico, Portici, San Giovanni a Teduccio, Centro Storico, Frullone). This resolves the "campus: to be verified" flag in the research brief and is the single most consequential practical fact about this programme.

The orientamento portal's Directions field gives: "Azienda Agricola Regionale Sperimentale Improsta – SS 18 – Tirrena Inferiore – Km 79+800 84025 EBOLI (SA)", and its Timetable field: "Courses start at 9.00 at the Regional experimental agricultural farm 'Improsta' SS 18 – Tirrenia Inferiore – Km 79+800 84025 EBOLI (SA)". The Didactic Regulations, Art. 2, describe the site: "L'intero percorso di studi è svolto in forma residenziale presso l'azienda sperimentale Regionale Improsta in cui, oltre ad una superficie a seminativi di circa 100 ha, è presente un allevamento di 150 bufale adulte da latte, un caseificio sperimentale e diversi laboratori." (approx. 100 ha of arable land, a herd of 150 adult dairy buffalo, an experimental dairy and several laboratories). The orientamento portal adds that the site has "classrooms to ensure frontal teaching, study rooms, computer rooms, a guesthouse equipped for students and a canteen".

ACCOMMODATION AND MEALS ARE PART OF THE OFFER, BUT CAPPED. The Department's enrolment page states: "The Master's Degree Programme in Precision Livestock Farming (PLF) provides free accommodation and meals at the Improsta Farm residential facilities for a maximum of 25 students (10 EU students and 15 non-EU students). ... Only the first 25 students in the final ranking (10 EU and 15 non-EU students) will be entitled to free accommodation and meals at Improsta Farm. Students enrolled beyond this quota may attend the programme but will not be provided with accommodation and will be responsible for arranging and covering their own housing expenses."

ADMINISTRATIVE ADDRESSES ARE IN NAPLES, and applicants must not confuse them with the teaching site: the Department (DMVPA) is at Via Federico Delpino 1, 80137 Napoli; the competent Student Secretariat (Segreteria Studenti Area Didattica Medicina Veterinaria) is at Via Tommaso De Amicis 95, 80131 Napoli, open to the public Monday/Wednesday/Friday 09.00–12.00 and Tuesday/Thursday 09.00–12.00 and 14.30–16.30; the Didactic Office is at Via Mezzocannone 8, 80134 Napoli.
degree_class: LM-86 — Italian degree class LM-86 "Scienze Zootecniche e Tecnologie Animali" (Animal Science and Technologies). Stated on the orientamento.unina.it course sheet ("Degree class LM-86") and in the Didactic Regulations header ("CLASSE LM-86") and Art. 1 ("classe LM-86 – Scienze Zootecniche e Tecnologie Animali"). The 2026/27 Rectoral admission decree and its amendment both use the extended form "classe LM-86 R (classe delle lauree magistrali in Scienze zootecniche e tecnologie animali)", and the Didactic Regulations are filed under the code "LM86 R". The "R" suffix is the ministerial marker carried in the University's course coding; the substantive class is LM-86 and the brief's value is confirmed. Course code on unina.it: 19378533 (an older record also exists under 21258262).
admission_type:
RESTRICTED ACCESS — "Numero Programmato Locale" (locally-programmed numerus clausus), by a published competitive admission call (bando di concorso) issued annually as a Rectoral Decree. The orientamento.unina.it course sheet header states "Admission Numero Programmato Locale". The Didactic Regulations, Art. 5(3): "L'accesso al CdS in Precision Livestock farming è a numero limitato e viene programmato annualmente a livello locale. Il numero programmato è motivato soprattutto dalle caratteristiche del percorso formativo che è di tipo residenziale presso l'azienda agricola Improsta. Inoltre, nell'ambito delle attività curriculari sono previste lezioni teorico-pratiche e laboratori didattici da impartire a gruppi di studenti di numero limitato di 5-10 per turno affinché le attività siano efficaci e si svolgano in sicurezza." This is a materially different regime from Federico II's open-access English-taught Master's degrees (e.g. Sustainable Food Systems): a candidate here can meet every requirement and still be refused a place if not high enough in the merit ranking.

No TOLC, no SAT, no written entrance examination. Selection is "per soli titoli" (on qualifications alone), with TWO SEPARATE AND DIFFERENT PROCEDURES running in parallel:

(1) EU CITIZENS + NON-EU CITIZENS LEGALLY RESIDENT IN ITALY (25 places). Application is made exclusively online through the SegrePass portal (https://www.segrepass1.unina.it/Welcome.do) in response to the bando; there is no application fee ("Per la partecipazione al concorso i candidati non sono tenuti al versamento di alcun contributo"). Ranking is by the weighted average of marks obtained in the examinations of the bachelor's degree used as the entry qualification (Art. 6 of the decree). Ties are broken in favour of the younger candidate (art. 2, c. 9, Law 191/98).

(2) NON-EU CITIZENS RESIDING ABROAD (15 reserved places). These candidates do NOT use SegrePass; they apply through the Universitaly portal under the MUR international-student rules, and are assessed by the Programme Coordinator on their CV/qualifications plus an interview that may be held remotely. Decree, Art. 6: "Per i cittadini non comunitari residenti all'estero, la selezione verrà effettuata mediante valutazione dei curricula e colloqui che verranno svolti anche a distanza direttamente a cura del Coordinamento Didattico del Corso di Laurea Magistrale." A separate ranking is drawn up for them: "Per i cittadini non comunitari residenti all'estero sarà formata apposita graduatoria separata con i criteri sopra indicati. Essi concorreranno per una graduatoria esclusiva per la copertura dei posti ad essi riservati." Didactic Regulations, Art. 5(5): "L'iscrizione degli studenti non-EU avviene tramite iscrizione sulla piattaforma Universitaly (https://www.universitaly.it/), le cui tempistiche di apertura e chiusura sono definite annualmente."

Unfilled non-EU places roll over to EU candidates: "I posti riservati ai cittadini non comunitari residenti all'estero che non verranno coperti saranno assegnati ai candidati comunitari utilmente collocati in graduatoria."

Applicants transferring from another Federico II Master's programme or from another university must also enter this competition and be placed in the ranking (Art. 5 of the decree).
academic_requirements:
ENTRY QUALIFICATION. A three-year bachelor's degree (laurea triennale) or a university diploma of three years' duration, or an equivalent foreign qualification. Didactic Regulations, Art. 4: "Per l'accesso al Corso di studio Magistrale Precision Livestock Farming occorre essere in possesso di una Laurea o del Diploma universitario di durata triennale, ovvero di altro titolo di studio conseguito all'estero. Occorre altresì il possesso di requisiti curriculari, conoscenze di base ed il superamento di una verifica dell'adeguatezza della personale preparazione. Inoltre, la verifica del livello della conoscenza della lingua Inglese è richiesta." The admission decree adds that holders of a foreign qualification may compete if it has been "riconosciuto equipollente da una Università italiana con apposito decreto rettorale", or (for non-EU candidates abroad) under the MUR international-student procedures.

A) CURRICULAR REQUIREMENTS — automatic route (eligible degree classes). Satisfied automatically by holders of:
• ex D.M. 270/2004: Class L-25 Scienze e Tecnologie Agrarie e Forestali (Agricultural and Forestry Sciences and Technologies); Class L-38 Scienze Zootecniche e Tecnologie delle Produzioni Animali (Animal Science and Production Technologies); Class LM-42 Medicina Veterinaria (Veterinary Medicine — a single-cycle Master's, listed here as an entry qualification).
• ex D.M. 509/1999: Class 20 Scienze e Tecnologie Agrarie, Agroalimentari e Forestali; Class 40 Scienze e Tecnologie Zootecniche e delle Produzioni Animali; Class 47/S Medicina Veterinaria.
IMPORTANT PROCEDURAL POINT: the 2026/27 decree as originally issued (DR/2026/2496 of 25.6.2026, Art. 2) listed ONLY L-38 and Class 40. This was corrected by amendment DR/2026/2636 of 08.7.2026, which found that "all'articolo 2, comma 1, del bando sopracitato non sono state indicate, per mero errore materiale, tutte le classi di laurea e laurea magistrale costituenti requisito di accesso" and substituted the full six-class list above. Any applicant reading only the original decree would have wrongly concluded that an L-25 or LM-42 degree was ineligible.

B) CURRICULAR REQUIREMENTS — credit route (all other degree classes, including foreign degrees). Admission is possible after verification of the previous career and recognition of a minimum number of credits in the characterising scientific-disciplinary sectors. THE PUBLISHED CREDIT THRESHOLD IS CONTRADICTORY — see uncertainty_notes:
• Didactic Regulations, Art. 4 — 40 CFU: "È possibile l'iscrizione di studenti laureati in altre classi di laurea previa verifica del percorso curriculare svolto e il riconoscimento di almeno 40 CFU nei seguenti settori caratterizzanti, identificati come requisito minimo".
• orientamento.unina.it (a.y. 2026/2027) — 40 ECTS: "Students with other degree classes may be enrolled after verification of their curricular path and recognition of at least 40 ECTS in the characterizing sectors (minimum requirement)".
• Department admission-requirements page — 40 CFU: "Graduates from other graduating classes may be admitted to the Master Degree in PLF, upon verification of their studies. At least 40 CFU in the following scientific disciplines would have been acquired".
• BUT the 2026/27 admission decree, Art. 2 — 60 CFU: "Possono partecipare, inoltre, al concorso coloro che siano in possesso di lauree triennali conseguite in classi di laurea diverse da quelle sopra elencate, purché abbiano conseguito, complessivamente, nel percorso curriculare svolto almeno 60 CFU nei seguenti settori scientifico disciplinari caratterizzanti, identificati come requisito minimo".
The decree is the legally operative document for the competition, so an applicant from an unlisted class should plan on 60 CFU for a.y. 2026/27.

THE EIGHT CHARACTERISING SECTORS (identical in all sources; the Department page uses the post-2024 SSD codes, the older documents the legacy codes): VET/01 = MVET-01/A Anatomia degli animali domestici / Veterinary Anatomy; VET/02 = MVET-01/B Fisiologia animale / Veterinary Physiology; AGR/01 = AGRI-01/A Economia ed estimo rurale / Agricultural and Food Economics and Rural Appraisal; AGR/02 = AGRI-02/A Agronomia e coltivazioni erbacee / Agronomy and Field Crops; AGR/17 = AGRI-09/A Zootecnica generale e miglioramento genetico / Livestock Systems, Animal Breeding and Genetics; AGR/18 = AGRI-09/B Nutrizione e alimentazione animale / Animal Nutrition and Feeding; AGR/19 = AGRI-09/C Zootecnica speciale / Animal Science; AGR/20 = AGRI-09/D Zoocolture / Aquaculture, Poultry and Rabbit Science.

Candidates outside classes L-38/40 are admitted to the competition CONDITIONALLY and their position is confirmed only after the CCD reviews their career: "I candidati che non siano in possesso del titolo di laurea conseguito nelle classi di laurea di cui sopra (L-38 o 40), sono ammessi con riserva alla procedura concorsuale. La riserva stessa verrà sciolta all'esito della valutazione delle carriere pregresse che verrà effettuata dal Consiglio di Coordinamento didattico. La verifica avrà ad oggetto i contenuti disciplinari e gli obiettivi formativi dei singoli insegnamenti o delle attività che hanno contribuito al conseguimento dei crediti."

C) BASIC KNOWLEDGE (conoscenze di base). Required in Mathematics, General/Organic/Inorganic Chemistry and Biochemistry, plus the eight characterising disciplines listed above. orientamento.unina.it: "Applicants are expected to possess basic knowledge in key scientific disciplines, including Mathematics, General Chemistry, Organic Chemistry, Inorganic Chemistry, and Biochemistry, as well as the minimum requirements specified above."

D) ADEQUATE PERSONAL PREPARATION (mandatory for everyone). Didactic Regulations, Art. 4: assessment of the previous career is the responsibility of the CCD. Automatic pass: a bachelor's degree awarded with a final grade of 91/110 or higher ("La verifica dell'adeguatezza della personale preparazione si ritiene assolta se il laureato ha ottenuto un voto di laurea uguale o superiore a 91/110"). Below 91/110, the candidate must sit an oral interview on the basic knowledge described above. For candidates not yet graduated at the close of matriculation but graduating by the final date set by the Academic Bodies, the requirement is satisfied if the weighted average of the university career is 25/30 or higher; below 25/30 the oral interview applies. Art. 5(2): "La verifica della personale preparazione è obbligatoria in ogni caso, e possono accedervi solo gli studenti in possesso dei requisiti curriculari."

E) GRADUATING CANDIDATES. Applicants who will graduate by 31 October 2026 may compete for a.y. 2026/27. Those who graduated outside Federico II must send a self-certification of the award by 10 November 2026. Decree, Art. 2: "Possono, inoltre, partecipare al concorso coloro i quali conseguiranno la laurea entro e non oltre il 31 ottobre 2026. ... Sono, automaticamente, esclusi dal concorso coloro i quali non conseguano il titolo di laurea entro il termine del 31 ottobre 2026."

F) ENGLISH. B2 (CEFR) is a hard requirement for all applicants — see language_requirements.

G) CONSEQUENCE OF NOT MEETING REQUIREMENTS. Decree, Art. 2: "La mancanza dei requisiti, indicati nel presente articolo, per l'accesso al corso determinerà l'esclusione dalla procedura concorsuale in ogni sua fase o l'esclusione dal corso stesso, laddove sia stata già effettuata l'iscrizione." The Department's enrolment page also notes a remedial route: "Where deficiencies are identified, students may be required to attend specific remedial courses aimed at strengthening their competencies and ensuring adequate preparation for the programme."
language_requirements:
ENGLISH — B2 (CEFR), compulsory for ALL applicants, EU and non-EU alike. The requirement appears identically in all four official sources.
• 2026/27 admission decree, Art. 2: "Per tutti gli studenti è richiesto un livello di conoscenza della lingua inglese B2, che, laddove non certificato ufficialmente, sarà verificato mediante placement test."
• Didactic Regulations, Art. 4 ("Verifica della conoscenza della lingua Inglese (livello B2)"): "Per l'accesso al corso di studio Magistrale in Precision Livestock Farming è richiesta la conoscenza della lingua inglese di livello B2 del Quadro Comune Europeo per la conoscenza delle lingue. Laddove tale conoscenza non sia certificata ufficialmente, sarà verificata mediante placement test." Art. 5(6) repeats it explicitly for both EU and non-EU candidates.
• orientamento.unina.it: "An English language B2 level is requested. If the latter is not officially certified, it will be verified by means of a placement test."
• Department admission-requirements page: "The graduate program can enroll students holding a certificate of proficiency in English internationally recognized. The minimum score is recognized equal to B2. If the English language is not officially recognized, a placement test supported by linguistic structures of university will be performed."

HOW IT IS PROVED. Two routes: (1) an internationally recognised English certificate at B2 or above; or (2) the University's own placement test, administered by the University's language structures (Centro Linguistico di Ateneo). No unina.it or department page publishes a list of accepted certificates or a score table mapping IELTS/TOEFL/Cambridge results to B2 — the requirement is stated only in CEFR terms, and no placement-test dates for a.y. 2026/27 were published at the research date. Note also that the B2 check is separate from the merit ranking: it is an eligibility condition, and passing it earns no ranking points (the EU ranking is built solely on the bachelor's weighted average).

ITALIAN — NOT required. Because the programme is officially registered as English-taught, the University's central rule applies (international.unina.it): "If you choose a three-year, five-year or single-cycle degree course in ENGLISH, level B2 Italian language proficiency is not required." The B2 Italian certificate (CLIQ system) and the Italian proficiency test apply only to Italian-taught programmes. international.unina.it adds a practical visa caveat: "Remember that an international certificate attesting to the level of English language skills (IELTS, TOEFL, Cambridge, etc.) is useful for the issue of the visa by the diplomatic/consular Representation." So although Federico II will accept a placement test in place of a certificate, a non-EU applicant may still need a paper certificate at the Embassy stage — and, since the non-EU selection is a documentary/interview assessment run by the Coordinator before the visa is issued, a certificate is in practice close to indispensable for that route.

Italian will nonetheless matter for daily life: the teaching site is a working farm in Eboli (province of Salerno), and all administrative dealings with the Student Secretariat, the SegrePass portal and the admission decree itself are in Italian only.

Decree, Art. 3: "La domanda di partecipazione al concorso dovrà essere presentata dai cittadini italiani, comunitari e non comunitari residenti in Italia, esclusivamente tramite procedura telematica, a partire dalla data di emanazione del presente bando ed entro e non oltre le ore 14.00 del 28 settembre 2026."

"La procedura informatica di presentazione delle domande verrà disattivata, tassativamente, alle ore 14,00 del 28 settembre 2026 e, pertanto, non sarà più possibile la compilazione dell'istanza di partecipazione al concorso." Bank transfers and post-office payments are not accepted. Candidates who miss it "saranno considerati tacitamente rinunciatari e decadranno definitivamente dal diritto all'immatricolazione".

• After 12 October 2026 — SCORRIMENTI (ranking slides). Vacant places go to eligible candidates further down the ranking, with notices published at least weekly: "Qualora, dopo aver effettuato gli scorrimenti sopra indicati, risultino ancora posti vacanti e candidati idonei si procederà a successivi scorrimenti fino ad esaurimento dei posti e candidati idonei. I relativi avvisi verranno pubblicati, almeno, con cadenza settimanale".

• 2026-12-31 — ABSOLUTE FINAL DATE for all matriculations: "Le immatricolazioni termineranno, comunque, entro il 31 dicembre 2026."
• Within 15 days of matriculating — the documentation already submitted online must be printed and delivered to the Student Secretariat counter (Via Tommaso De Amicis 95, Naples).

NOTE ON THE UNIVERSITY-WIDE CALENDAR. The general Guida all'iscrizione 2026/27 sets an ordinary matriculation window of 16 July 2026 – 2 November 2026 with late-enrolment surcharges (€50 to 15 January 2027; €110 from 16 January 2027) and an outer limit of 31 March 2027 for first-year Master's enrolment. Those dates DO NOT apply to Precision Livestock Farming: the bando's own 12 October 2026 / 31 December 2026 dates prevail, and there is no late-enrolment-with-surcharge route into a numerus clausus course. The only element of the general guide that still bites is the fee calendar (first instalment plus regional tax and stamp duty by 2 November 2026, second instalment by 1 March 2027, third by 30 April 2027) and the 2 November 2026 deadline for the ISEEU income data to be retrievable from the INPS database.

The Didactic Regulations describe the recurring pattern for future years: "L'iscrizione degli studenti EU avviene attraverso la partecipazione ad un bando di ammissione che viene emanato di solito nel mese di Giugno/Luglio e si chiude nel mese di Settembre." Applicants for later years should expect a late-June/July call closing in late September.
application_deadline_non_eu:
[uncertain] Non-EU citizens residing abroad follow a SEPARATE and EARLIER track that is not fully documented in one place; the dates below are assembled from the University-wide international pages, the admission decree and the Department's published documents, all for a.y. 2026/2027.

• 2026-06-15 — Universitaly pre-enrolment deadline, WITH AN EXPLICIT EXCEPTION THAT COVERS THIS PROGRAMME. international.unina.it: "JUNE – 15 – 2026 – Pre-enrolment application deadline to University of Naples Federico II. After this date no programme changes are permitted. After this date pre-enrolment is allowed to the programmes with restricted access only." Because Precision Livestock Farming IS a restricted-access programme (numero programmato locale), pre-enrolment for it remains possible after 15 June 2026 — the opposite of the position for Federico II's open-access English-taught Master's degrees. The University does not publish the later cut-off that then applies. Pre-enrolment is made exclusively through https://www.universitaly.it/studenti-stranieri, indicating the University of Naples Federico II, the PLF programme, and the Embassy/Consulate where the visa will be requested.
• Selection by the Coordinator, on dates not published. Decree, Art. 6: non-EU candidates abroad are assessed "mediante valutazione dei curricula e colloqui che verranno svolti anche a distanza direttamente a cura del Coordinamento Didattico del Corso di Laurea Magistrale" — CV evaluation plus an interview that may be held remotely, run by Prof. Francesco Vinale's coordination. No application form, no submission address and no deadline for this route is stated in the decree, which in Art. 3 describes the SegrePass procedure only for "cittadini italiani, comunitari e non comunitari residenti in Italia".
• 2026-07-06 — the Department published a document titled "Final ranking non EU 2026-27" on its PLF enrolment page. This is nearly THREE MONTHS BEFORE the 28 September 2026 EU application deadline, which confirms that the non-EU-abroad selection runs on its own, much earlier calendar aligned with the visa timetable rather than with the bando. Any non-EU applicant who waits for the September bando deadline will have missed this programme's non-EU selection entirely.
• 2026-11-30 — visa application deadline. international.unina.it: "NOVEMBER – 30 – 2026 – Deadline for submitting the Visa Application at Iyalian Embassies /Consulates." [typo as published]
• 2026-12-31 — the decree's absolute final matriculation date applies to everyone: "Le immatricolazioni termineranno, comunque, entro il 31 dicembre 2026."
• Matriculation is IN PERSON for this group. Decree, Art. 9: "I cittadini non comunitari residenti all'estero dovranno effettuare le operazioni di immatricolazione direttamente presso l'Ufficio di Segreteria Studenti suddetto" (Via Tommaso De Amicis 95, Naples) — they cannot use the online SegrePass matriculation route.
• NO ADMISSION LETTER IS ISSUED FOR VISA PURPOSES. international.unina.it states flatly: "Important! The University of Naples Federico II does not issue admission letters for obtaining a visa." NO written entrance examination, NO TOLC, NO SAT, NO portfolio. Selection is "per soli titoli" (on qualifications alone). The 2026/27 decree records the Coordinator's confirmation of the method used in previous years: "SENTITO il coordinatore del corso di studio di cui sopra, prof. Francesco Vinale, circa l'opportunità di confermare le modalità di selezione già utilizzate negli scorsi anni accademici, ossia di svolgere la selezione per soli titoli". Four distinct assessments nevertheless exist, and only the first is competitive:

1) COMPETITIVE RANKING — EU citizens and non-EU citizens resident in Italy. Ranking by the weighted average of the marks obtained in the examinations of the bachelor's degree declared as the entry qualification, in descending order. Decree, Art. 7: "La graduatoria di merito sarà formulata, per i cittadini comunitari, secondo l'ordine decrescente della media ponderata riportata negli esami di profitto, superati nell'ambito del corso di laurea indicato dal candidato quale requisito partecipativo. L'iscrizione avverrà fino alla copertura dei posti messi a concorso ed indicati all'articolo 1 del presente bando. In caso di parità di punteggio, prevale il candidato più giovane". Nothing else counts — not the degree class, not a motivation letter, not work experience, not English level.

2) COMPETITIVE RANKING — non-EU citizens residing abroad. A separate ranking based on CV/qualifications plus an interview, which may be conducted remotely, held directly by the Programme's Didactic Coordination: "Per i cittadini non comunitari residenti all'estero, la selezione verrà effettuata mediante valutazione dei curricula e colloqui che verranno svolti anche a distanza direttamente a cura del Coordinamento Didattico del Corso di Laurea Magistrale." No scoring grid, interview syllabus or date list is published. The Didactic Regulations, Art. 5(4), describe the criteria as "del curriculum e di tutti i titoli presentati dai candidati non-EU" (versus, for EU candidates, "della media degli esami sostenuti, del voto di Laurea e di un colloquio orale").

3) PERSONAL-PREPARATION INTERVIEW (pass/fail eligibility check, not competitive). Automatically waived for candidates with a bachelor's degree of 91/110 or higher, or — for candidates still graduating — a weighted career average of 25/30 or higher. Everyone below those thresholds must sit "un colloquio orale finalizzato a valutare le conoscenze di base descritte in precedenza" (Mathematics; general, organic and inorganic Chemistry; Biochemistry; and the eight characterising VET/AGR disciplines). The Regulations stress: "La verifica della personale preparazione è obbligatoria in ogni caso, e possono accedervi solo gli studenti in possesso dei requisiti curriculari."

4) ENGLISH PLACEMENT TEST (pass/fail eligibility check, only if no official B2 certificate). "Per tutti gli studenti è richiesto un livello di conoscenza della lingua inglese B2, che, laddove non certificato ufficialmente, sarà verificato mediante placement test." Administered by the University's language structures. No dates published for a.y. 2026/27.

REMEDIAL PROVISION. The Department's enrolment page notes: "Where deficiencies are identified, students may be required to attend specific remedial courses aimed at strengthening their competencies and ensuring adequate preparation for the programme." No further detail (subjects, cost, duration, timing) is published.

PRACTICAL IMPLICATION for an international applicant with a foreign bachelor's degree: the decisive factor on the EU/Italy-resident route is a single number — the weighted average of the undergraduate transcript — which must be self-certified in the SegrePass form and is verified afterwards. On the non-EU-abroad route the decisive factor is a coordinator interview whose criteria are unpublished.

40 places for a.y. 2026/2027 — but the published figures are internally inconsistent and the number that actually matters to a candidate depends on which of two quotas is meant. Read carefully:

THE 40 FIGURE (total admissions). The CCD resolution behind the decree set "il numero degli iscrivibili pari a 40 unità, di cui 15 posti riservati per i cittadini non comunitari residenti all'estero" (CCD deliberation no. 2/2026 of 19.5.2026, approved by DR 2340 of 16.6.2026). Decree, Art. 1, then lists: "numero 25 posti per cittadini comunitari e non comunitari regolarmente residenti in Italia; numero 15 posti riservati a cittadini non comunitari residenti all'estero." 25 + 15 = 40. The orientamento.unina.it course sheet (a.y. 2026/2027) states the same total: "The access to the PLF Master Degree is limited to n. 40 (25 EU citizens or non-EU citizens legally residing in Italy + 15 non-EU citizen) students who will be selected with procedure defined by the Didactic Coordination Committee."

THE 25 FIGURE (residential places with free board and lodging). The same decree's Art. 1 opening clause says the competition is announced "per un numero massimo di 25 unità" — apparently a residue of the residential-capacity constraint recorded in the CCD resolution: "Resta invariata la disponibilità di vitto e alloggio presso la struttura Improsta di Eboli, che continuerà ad essere garantita a un massimo di 25 studenti iscritti." The Department's own enrolment page confirms that 25 is the accommodation quota and splits it differently: "The Master's Degree Programme in Precision Livestock Farming (PLF) provides free accommodation and meals at the Improsta Farm residential facilities for a maximum of 25 students (10 EU students and 15 non-EU students). ... Only the first 25 students in the final ranking (10 EU and 15 non-EU students) will be entitled to free accommodation and meals at Improsta Farm. Students enrolled beyond this quota may attend the programme but will not be provided with accommodation and will be responsible for arranging and covering their own housing expenses."

BEST READING: 40 students may be admitted (25 general + 15 non-EU reserved), of whom only the top 25 in the ranking (per the Department, 10 EU + 15 non-EU) receive free accommodation and meals at Improsta. An EU candidate ranked 11th–25th on the general list would therefore be admitted but would have to find and pay for housing near Eboli — a rural location where the University offers no alternative student residence. Note also the historical drift in this figure: an earlier version of the orientamento sheet stated "limited to 25 students (10 Italians + 15 foreigners)", so the total was raised to 40 for 2026/27 while the residential capacity stayed at 25.

The cap is justified by the residential and small-group teaching model: "nell'ambito delle attività curriculari sono previste lezioni teorico-pratiche e laboratori didattici da impartire a gruppi di studenti di numero limitato di 5-10 per turno affinché le attività siano efficaci e si svolgano in sicurezza."
non_eu_reserved_seats:
15 places reserved for non-EU citizens residing abroad, for a.y. 2026/2027. Decree DR/2026/2496, Art. 1: "numero 15 posti riservati a cittadini non comunitari residenti all'estero." Confirmed by the CCD resolution ("di cui 15 posti riservati per i cittadini non comunitari residenti all'estero"), by the orientamento.unina.it course sheet ("n. 40 (25 EU citizens or non-EU citizens legally residing in Italy + 15 non-EU citizen)") and by the Department's enrolment page ("15 non-EU students").

This is unusually generous — 37.5% of all places — and it is the single most favourable structural feature of this programme for a non-EU applicant. These 15 candidates compete only against each other in a dedicated ranking ("apposita graduatoria separata ... Essi concorreranno per una graduatoria esclusiva per la copertura dei posti ad essi riservati"), and all 15 non-EU places carry free accommodation and meals at Improsta according to the Department's 10-EU + 15-non-EU split of the 25 residential places.

TWO IMPORTANT CAVEATS. (1) The reservation is one-directional: unfilled non-EU places revert to EU candidates — "I posti riservati ai cittadini non comunitari residenti all'estero che non verranno coperti saranno assegnati ai candidati comunitari utilmente collocati in graduatoria" (decree, Art. 1) and "Nel caso di mancata copertura dei posti riservati a studenti non-EU, i posti non coperti potranno essere assegnati a studenti italiani secondo l'ordine progressivo della graduatoria" (Didactic Regulations, Art. 5(4)) — with no equivalent provision transferring unfilled EU places to non-EU candidates. (2) The reservation applies only to non-EU citizens RESIDING ABROAD. Non-EU citizens legally resident in Italy are pooled with EU candidates into the 25 general places and are ranked on the bachelor's weighted average like everyone else.

First-year students pay a "contributo agevolato" based on ISEEU: fully exempt up to €30,000 (no-tax area); above that, a fixed component of €1,011.50 plus a variable component, up to a maximum of €2,384.00 for those filing no ISEEU declaration. On top comes the compulsory regional tax for the right to study: €130.00 (ISEEU ≤ €25,500, and students from particularly poor countries under art. 13(5) DPCM 9 April 2001 / D.M. 176 of 24 February 2026), €151.00 (ISEEU €25,500.01–€51,000, AND students whose family unit resides abroad), or €173.00 (ISEEU > €51,000 or no ISEEU), plus €16.00 stamp duty. Payment in three instalments: 60% + regional tax + stamp duty from 16 July (or 1 September) and by 2 November 2026; 20% by 1 March 2027; 20% by 30 April 2027. A 50% reduction applies to a first-year Master's student who obtained the bachelor's degree by 31 October of the third in-course year with 110 e lode.
(b) Flat international-student scheme (international.unina.it, "Fees"): "– Eropean students €200/year (tuition fees) + €140/year regional tax (compulsory) + €16.00 legal stamp (compulsory) – Non-european students €140/year regional fee (compulsory) + €16.00 legal stamp (compulsory)" [spelling as published].

(ii) The first instalment and the regional tax must be paid through SegrePass by 12 October 2026 on pain of exclusion — earlier than the University's general 2 November 2026 fee deadline — and "Non sono ammessi, a pena di esclusione, pagamenti con bonifico bancario o presso gli uffici postali." (iii) Students transferring in from another Federico II course pay a transfer contribution (€96 per the Guida) by 10 October 2026. (iv) THE LARGEST FINANCIAL VARIABLE IS NOT TUITION BUT ACCOMMODATION: free board and lodging at Improsta is worth far more than the fee itself and is guaranteed only to the top 25 in the ranking; students admitted beyond that quota "will be responsible for arranging and covering their own housing expenses" in a rural area with no university residence. (v) Non-tuition costs for a non-EU student: proof of means of subsistence of €10,179.85/year for the study visa, plus residence-permit costs.

4) MATERIAL CONFLICT — 40 CFU vs 60 CFU for applicants from other degree classes. THIS IS THE MOST CONSEQUENTIAL DISCREPANCY IN THIS RECORD. The Didactic Regulations (Art. 4), the orientamento.unina.it 2026/2027 course sheet and the Department's admission-requirements page all say "at least 40 CFU" in the eight characterising sectors. The 2026/27 admission decree (Art. 2), which is the legally binding instrument for the competition and was NOT amended on this point, says "almeno 60 CFU" in the same eight sectors. A candidate from, say, a biology or agricultural-engineering bachelor's degree with 45 CFU in these sectors would be eligible under the Regulations and ineligible under the decree. The decree should be treated as controlling for a.y. 2026/27, and the point should be put in writing to the Coordinator (frvinale@unina.it) before applying. Note that the eight sectors themselves are identical in every source; only the threshold differs.

5) MATERIAL DEFECT ALREADY CORRECTED — eligible degree classes. The admission decree as originally issued listed only classes L-38 and 40 as eligible, omitting L-25, LM-42, 20 and 47/S "per mero errore materiale". Amendment DR/2026/2636 of 8 July 2026 restored the full list. Anyone reading only the original bando PDF (or a cached copy, or a third-party aggregator that scraped it in early July) would wrongly conclude that an Agricultural Sciences (L-25) or Veterinary Medicine (LM-42) graduate cannot apply. Always read the bando together with the rettifica.

6) SEAT FIGURES ARE INTERNALLY INCONSISTENT IN THE DECREE ITSELF. Art. 1 of DR/2026/2496 announces the competition "per un numero massimo di 25 unità" and then, in the same sentence, lists "25 posti" + "15 posti" = 40. The CCD resolution quoted in the preamble sets "il numero degli iscrivibili pari a 40 unità" while guaranteeing board and lodging at Improsta "a un massimo di 25 studenti iscritti". The Department's enrolment page reconciles this by treating 25 as the ACCOMMODATION quota, split 10 EU + 15 non-EU. Best reading: 40 admitted, 25 housed. But the 10/15 accommodation split published by the Department does not appear in the decree, and an EU candidate ranked 11th or lower on the general list has no published guarantee of housing. This is a €thousands-per-year question in a rural location with no university residence, and it should be confirmed with the Coordinator before accepting a place. Note also that an earlier version of the orientamento sheet stated a total of "25 students (10 Italians + 15 foreigners)", so the total was raised to 40 for 2026/27 while residential capacity stayed at 25 — the leftover "25" in Art. 1 is probably an un-updated remnant.

7) NON-EU-ABROAD PROCEDURE IS THE LARGEST DOCUMENTATION GAP. The decree's Art. 3 sets out the SegrePass application procedure only for "cittadini italiani, comunitari e non comunitari residenti in Italia". For non-EU candidates residing abroad it states only that selection happens "mediante valutazione dei curricula e colloqui ... a cura del Coordinamento Didattico" — with NO application form, NO submission address, NO document list, NO deadline and NO scoring criteria published anywhere on unina.it or mvpa-unina.org. Meanwhile the Department published a "Final ranking non EU 2026-27" on 6 July 2026, almost three months BEFORE the EU application deadline of 28 September 2026, which proves that the non-EU selection ran on a separate and much earlier calendar that was never published. A non-EU applicant relying on the September date would have missed this cycle entirely. Direct early contact with Prof. Francesco Vinale (frvinale@unina.it) and Prof. Laura Rinaldi (lrinaldi@unina.it) is not optional for this route — it is the only reliable channel.

8) RESTRICTED-ACCESS EXCEPTION TO THE UNIVERSITALY DEADLINE, WITH NO REPLACEMENT DATE. international.unina.it sets 15 June 2026 as the pre-enrolment deadline but adds "After this date pre-enrolment is allowed to the programmes with restricted access only." PLF is restricted-access, so the 15 June cut-off does not bind it — yet the University publishes no later cut-off for restricted-access programmes. The operative limits then become the 30 November 2026 visa deadline and the decree's 31 December 2026 final matriculation date.

9) NO ADMISSION LETTER FOR VISA PURPOSES. international.unina.it states: "The University of Naples Federico II does not issue admission letters for obtaining a visa." This differs from the pre-acceptance-letter practice advertised by some other Federico II departments (e.g. Agricultural Sciences for Sustainable Food Systems) and can be a practical obstacle at consulates that expect one. Non-EU applicants should raise it with the Coordinator early and rely on the Universitaly pre-enrolment summary validated by the University, plus (per the decree) their position in the separate non-EU ranking.

10) TUITION FIGURES CONFLICT INTERNALLY. international.unina.it publishes a flat scheme (EU €200 tuition + €140 regional tax + €16 stamp; non-EU €140 + €16) whose €140 regional tax matches none of the three 2026/27 brackets (€130 / €151 / €173) in the current student guide; the international page appears not to have been refreshed for 2026/27. No unina.it page states a PLF-specific fee. Also note that the decree's own payment deadline (12 October 2026, on pain of exclusion) is earlier than the general guide's 2 November 2026 first-instalment date, and that bank transfers and post-office payments are expressly refused.

11) ENGLISH B2 DETAILS UNPUBLISHED. No accepted-certificate list, no score table (IELTS/TOEFL/Cambridge equivalents to B2), no exemption rules and no placement-test dates for a.y. 2026/27 were available at the research date. The requirement is stated only in CEFR terms and only as a pass/fail eligibility gate — it earns no ranking points.

12) PERSONAL-PREPARATION INTERVIEW DATES UNPUBLISHED. Candidates below 91/110 (or below a 25/30 weighted average, if still graduating) must sit an oral interview on Mathematics, Chemistry, Biochemistry and the eight VET/AGR disciplines, but no dates, syllabus or format for 2026/27 are published. Since most foreign bachelor's grading scales do not map cleanly onto /110, essentially every international applicant may fall into this route by default — a material unknown for the target audience of this research.

13) SOURCE-DOMAIN CAVEAT. The task restricted sources to unina.it. The primary documents — the orientation course sheet, the admission decree, the amendment, the Annex 1 template, the Didactic Regulations, the student fee guide, the international pages and the numero-programmato index — are all on unina.it hosts (unina.it, old.unina.it, orientamento.unina.it, international.unina.it, erasmus.unina.it). However, the Department of Veterinary Medicine and Animal Production publishes its programme site on mvpa-unina.org, a separate top-level domain rather than a unina.it subdomain. It is unambiguously the official department site — it is linked from orientamento.unina.it as "Sito web del Dipartimento" and named in the Didactic Regulations as an official publication channel for the bando ("sul sito di Dipartimento di Medicina Veterinaria e Produzioni Animali (www.mvpa-unina.org)") — so it was used, but readers applying a strict unina.it-only rule should note that the accommodation quota (10 EU + 15 non-EU), the remedial-course provision, the new-format SSD codes and the existence of the July 2026 non-EU ranking come from that domain. Third-party aggregators (studenti.it, guida-uni.it, AlmaLaurea, Mastersportal, bestr.it) surfaced in search and were NOT used.

14) BROKEN / DEGRADED LINKS ENCOUNTERED. www.orientamento.unina.it presents an invalid TLS certificate chain to some clients ("unable to verify the first certificate"); www.erasmus.unina.it, which hosts the Didactic Regulations PDF, presents an expired certificate. Both were retrievable only with certificate verification relaxed. The unina.it document endpoints (/documents/d/guest/...) return an empty body to requests without a browser User-Agent. The University's own UniversItaly_2026_27.pdf information sheet has non-extractable embedded text, so the non-EU dates in this record were taken from the HTML pages on international.unina.it instead.

15) NO ENGLISH VERSION OF THE 2026/27 CALL WAS FOUND. The Didactic Regulations promise "un estratto del bando in lingua inglese" published for information only, and such extracts exist for earlier years (2019/20 on erasmus.unina.it; 2022/23 on mvpa-unina.org), but no 2026/27 English extract was located at the research date. The 13-page binding decree, its 2-page amendment and the Annex 1 self-certification template are all Italian-only — a real barrier for a programme that admits 15 non-EU students a year and is taught entirely in English.

16) SEPARATE UNIVERSITALY NON-EU CONTINGENT NOT CHECKED. As with all Italian programmes, a per-course contingent for non-EU candidates residing abroad is declared on universitaly.it. Here that figure should coincide with the 15 reserved places in the decree, but the Universitaly "Scheda" was deliberately not consulted under the unina.it-only source restriction.

17) COORDINATOR PHONE DISCREPANCY (minor). The orientamento portal gives Prof. Francesco Vinale's number as 081 2539330; the Department site footer gives 081 2539338 for the PLF Coordinator. E-mail (frvinale@unina.it) is the safer channel.
